integrity: The proof is analytic. The lower bound is a circle-covering argument and the matching upper bound is an explicit radial construction with an exact sector-diameter calculation; the displayed decimal is only a sanity check.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to eight-subdivisions of the Euclidean unit disk for which at least one region is disjoint from the outer circle; it does not determine the unrestricted eight-subdivision optimum or classify all interior equality interfaces.
title: Sharp one-core eight-subdivision threshold for the unit disk
